COMPROMISE (web-01): since 2026-10-29 the shared 'deploy' account was logged into 84 times BY PASSWORD from external IP 54.36.199.108 (zero failed attempts before, so the password was already known; last one 2026-11-12 14:20 UTC). Real CI uses a key from 10.20.0.30. deploy also had NOPASSWD sudo rsync on web-01 = root, so I treat web-01 root-readable secrets as exposed. I found no sign of the attacker on db-01 or ci-01 (no logins from that IP, no new keys/accounts/changed jobs; the web-01->db/ci logins are Maria/Nico/Theo from known IPs), no webshells, and no changed site files (availability.php is Theo's benign unlisted file). I cannot see the commands run in the sessions, so scope on web-01 is inferred.
DONE: web-01 - deploy now key-only in sshd (Match User deploy, PasswordAuthentication no); removed deploy's sudo rsync; locked jpark (account not in staff.txt, was in sudo group; also locked on ci-01); /var/www/internal/maint.d (which ci-01 maint can be switched to execute as root) no longer writable by deploy/www-data; wp-config.php now root:www-data 640; ci-01 repo config (holds GitHub token) was world-readable, now 660 root:developers. NOTE: Maria/old scripts logging in to deploy by password will fail (new password via help desk in ~8 min; use mreyes key instead). Not done / for you: staff passwords were not rotated (would lock people out) - consider it; SSH password auth for staff and %sudo NOPASSWD ALL remain; Grafana :3000 and node exporter :9100 are internet-facing; ci-01 GitHub token and bucket key not rotated (no evidence they were reached) - consider doing so.
